title: Output Hygiene And Quality Guards
description: Add backend helper functions and tests that treat English whitespace collapse, prompt leakage, too-short reading passages, and generic repeated questions as generation quality failures before content is saved or sent to TTS.

success: Generated English text with collapsed token spacing is detected or repaired before persistence/TTS.
Reading passages containing prompt instructions are rejected or routed to fallback.
Focused Go unit tests cover whitespace, prompt-leak, word/paragraph count, and generic question detection.
